newsitem.title: FRANCE: France worried over lack of dialogue in Serbia.
newsitem.headline: France worried over lack of dialogue in Serbia.

text.p: France said on Tuesday it was worried by the lack of dialogue between Serbia's socialist government and the Zajedno opposition coaliton despite weeks of opposition protests over alleged socialist election fraud.

"We are particularly concerned over the evolution of the situation in Serbia. No genuine discussions have yet been undertaken between the government and the opposition," a Foreign Ministry spokesman said.

The spokesman warned of the possibility of violence during demonstrations planned for Belgrade on Tuesday, a warning issued just as street fighting erupted in the Serb capital between government and opposition demonstrators.
"Street confrontations must be avoided at all cost," the spokesman said. "Only the path of dialogue will be able to bring about a peaceful and democratic settlement."
The Zajedno (Together) coalition has held 35 days of protests since the governing socialists last month annulled municipal election defeats in Belgrade and 14 other towns.
Tuesday's street fighting broke out during a socialist protest against the Zajedno demonstrations.
Zajedno officials said they feared socialist demonstrators would foment violence to give Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic an excuse to unleash his riot police or even call a state of emergency.
